description: This file defines the 'Compressed' formatter class within the SCSSPHP project, responsible for formatting SCSS output in a compressed form by removing unnecessary whitespace and comments.

classes.name: Compressed
classes.description: A formatter class specializing in outputting compressed CSS from SCSS input, inheriting from the base Formatter class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with settings suitable for producing compressed CSS output.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Processes and outputs a block of CSS lines, removing comments and concatenating lines efficiently.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors for a CSS rule, in a compact form, replacing complex combinators with simple characters.
